references.text: Also describes a situation where the wicked are punished with fire, which resembles the picture Jesus paints in Matthew 13:50.
John the Baptist speaks of a fire that burns up chaff, which can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' words about fire in Matthew 13:50.
Jesus speaks of eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels, which resonates with the image of fire in Matthew 13:50.
Revelation describes a lake of burning sulfur where the wicked are cast, parallel to the fire mentioned in Matthew 13:50.
Describes the second death in a lake of fire, which is consistent with the image of fire in Matthew 13:50.
